purpose: Prospective ontology for localizing cross-material transport success/failure without changing the primary discovery/held-out law.

L0_material_structure.rule: Only piece-type/count/side relations define material-family identity. No engine or intervention outcome may alter these coordinates.

L1_exact_world_context.rule: These coordinates may explain within-family variation but may not be used post hoc to regroup material families or redefine the discovery/held-out split.

L2_engine_process.rule: L2 is caused/measured under intervention and therefore cannot define the ontology used to select or regroup L0 families.

extrapolation_family.rule: Do not force-match this family to KRRvKR. Treat it as out-of-scaffold extrapolation rather than an analog substitution.

analog_phase_transport.prediction_rule: For each structural analog pair, predict the held-out phase label to equal its discovery analog's sealed phase label independently for each engine target.
analog_phase_transport.pass_rule: At least 2 of 3 analog pairs match on a target.
analog_phase_transport.cross_version_pass_rule: analog-phase transport passes independently on both engine targets.

bishop_to_knight_axis.prediction_rule: For each analog pair, preserve the sign of the MAINxQSEARCH interaction component after bishop-to-knight substitution.
bishop_to_knight_axis.pass_rule: At least 2 of 3 analog pairs preserve sign on a target.
bishop_to_knight_axis.interpretation: This is a topology-axis test, not a claim that bishops and knights are causally equivalent.

far_extrapolation.prediction_rule: KBBvKN is evaluated only against the global discovery law; no nearest-family rescue is permitted after outcome reveal.
far_extrapolation.interpretation: Failure here localizes extrapolation weakness but cannot by itself refute analog-substitution transport.

forbidden_post_outcome_moves: regroup families by observed intervention effect
move KBBvKN out of the held-out set
promote L1 world-context variables into constitutive family labels
collapse bishop and knight into one class after seeing outcomes
